body: Continue the signed watchdog implementation in the own scoped clone. For own-context verification, check permissions/binding and source only in the same shell with role current --check; never cat or print the context values, selectors or whole environment into logs. The selector is nonsecret metadata but the operational file is private. No real user keys/auth/transcripts/config or production journal writes from fixtures. Retain every signed B2391-1 producer/delivery/completeness gate; no policy weakening or partial COVERED_VENDORS admission.
subject: Context handling and implementation boundary
